stay.price_basis: No median: Kedarnath dham closes for winter before 18-19 Nov 2026. Closing is expected on Bhai Dooj, 11 Nov 2026 (tentative; BKTC confirms the date a few weeks ahead): https://www.bizarexpedition.com/blog/kedarnath-temple-opening-closing-dates , https://yatrio.in/kedarnath-temple-opening-and-closing-dates-2026/ . The idol moves to Omkareshwar temple, Ukhimath for winter. 2026 yatra season ran from 22 April 2026. GMVN's own booking pages say stays can be booked up to 30 Sep 2026 (per search-result text; gmvnonline.com returns 403 so the tariff pages could not be read).
stay.notes: Season tariff (unofficial, undated): dreamtripguide.com (article dated 7 May 2026) prints an 'Official 2026 GMVN Kedarnath Tariff Card' with approx per-room/bed prices: Swargarohini 4-bed suite 6,000 per room, 8-bed dorm 990 per bed, Nandi Complex dorm 750 per bed, Sumeru tents 400 per bed, Lincholi camp dorm 250-400 per bed; it says Sep/Oct is slightly cheaper than May/June peak but gives no per-season rows and cites no GMVN document, so it is NOT used as a figure. https://dreamtripguide.com/gmvn-kedarnath-booking-2026-how-to-reserve-rooms-and-dormitories-online/ . BKTC dharamshalas are quoted at 300-800 only by a blog; no BKTC printed tariff found. Cleartrip 'Kedarnath' lists (18-19 Nov 2026 dated pages open) are hotels in Sonprayag, Sitapur and Phata, 5-20 km and a day's trek below the temple, plus 4 with no rooms; Booking.com also shows a few Kedarnath tents (2,609-2,729) and some rooms for 18-19 Nov, but with the town shut for the season these cannot be treated as open lodging. Nothing borrowed from Guptkashi or Sonprayag.

stay.nearest_base: Lohajung (road head; Wan is the trek start)
stay.price_basis: No priced rooms for 18-19 Nov 2026. Roopkund itself (glacial lake, 4,800 m) and its camps (Bhagwabasa etc.) have no rooms; the trek is camp-based, 'bed basis' pay at Bhagwabasa with no amount printed (https://www.mountainiq.com/guides/trekking-in-india/uttarakhand-treks/roopkund-trek/). Season per operators: May-June and Sep-Oct; snow returns to higher ridges from late Oct and alpine meadows are snow-covered Nov-Apr (https://www.retreatsandtreks.com/treks/location/lohajung). Cleartrip has no hotels-in-roopkund/lohajung/wan pages (404) and Booking.com searches for Lohajung and Wan return no properties for 18-19 Nov 2026; a Booking search for 'Roopkund' only returns Tharali/Suna places (tens of km away), which were not borrowed.
stay.notes: Nearest base Lohajung has only 'basic guesthouses and a few lodges' per retreatsandtreks.com (no prices). A search-result summary mentioned a GMVN tourist lodge and a panchayat rest house at Lohajung, but no tariff was readable (gmvnonline.com returns 403) and no source for it was verified. Roopkund trek legal status in 2026 is murky (overnight bugyal camping ban 2018; some operators say reopened July 2026, mountainiq.com still says 'currently closed'). Trek packages are not room prices and were not used. Medians left null by rule: Roopkund base is closed or snowbound by mid-late Nov and nothing is priced.

unverified: No lodging price at Roopkund or Lohajung found
